title: K Closest Points to Origin
prompt:
Given `points[i] = [xi, yi]`, return the `k` points closest to the origin, in any order (the answer is guaranteed unique).

Distance comparison never needs the square root — compare `x² + y²` directly.

**Example**: `points = [[1,3],[-2,2]]`, `k = 1` → `[[-2,2]]`.
hints: Keep-smallest-k → MAX-heap of size k ordered by squared distance.
Offer each point; poll when size exceeds k; drain the heap into the result.

solution.explanation: O(n log k), O(k) space. Max-heap because we evict the FARTHEST while keeping the closest — the mirror of k-th largest. Squared distance keeps everything in integers.
